dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for the forest's alleviating effect on the disease... Someone with Eleazar would have never been allowed to be a Forest Ranger.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Eleazar?

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here? Why are you asking about that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye...

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Oh, bye then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm just passing by.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Right.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: This is Gandharva Ville. You can rest here if you're tired.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: If you don't want to be "educated" by the Forest Watchers, then take a look at the stuff on the noticeboard.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Forgive me for being unable to say more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a friend of Tighnari's.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that Forest Watcher's friend? My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Eleazar is a very troublesome disease in Sumeru. It makes scale-like objects grow on the patient's body.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: The Bimarstan says that it requires rest... But that patient became a Forest Ranger and is busy all day. Is that really okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd see the day when someone would be cured of Eleazar... though I suppose that'll mean the end of that young girl's time with the Forest Rangers soon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you referring to?

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here? Why are you asking about that?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm a friend of Tighnari's.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Oh, you're that Forest Watcher's friend, are you? My apologies.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: I'm referring to a Trainee Forest Ranger who's been stationed with us.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: She was here as part of her recuperation process from the first, so I reckon that she'll be leaving now that she's recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: Now, she has said that she wouldn't mind staying on as a Forest Ranger, but you know — people change their minds all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Kamran
dialogues.text: You can't even trust what the sages say nowadays, so I'm not sure how hopeful I should be about anyone or anything else, you know?
